summary: Tested CloudScore.ai marketing site — backend (FastAPI/MongoDB) and frontend (React landing page). 9/9 backend pytest tests passed (root, stats, demo-requests CRUD + validation). Full Playwright E2E confirmed all 21 sections render, KPIs (4m 12s/$412K/63%), 16 ASTRA agents, hero orchestration log streams, AI SRE timeline animates, nav anchor scroll works, mobile nav toggle works, and demo form POST returns 200 with id and shows success toast.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — consider lifespan handler (non-blocking).
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers ignore credentials with wildcard. For marketing site this is fine but flag for prod.
POST /api/demo-requests has no rate-limiting/captcha — public form vulnerable to spam/abuse. Recommend adding throttle or hCaptcha before launch.
DemoRequest stores PII (name+email+company+role+message) — ensure privacy policy + retention policy is documented.
POST returns 200 (FastAPI default) instead of 201 for resource creation — minor REST convention nit.
seed_data_creation: Created test demo-requests with TEST_ prefix during pytest and Playwright runs (test_user@example.com, test_full@example.com, test_list@example.com, test_pw@example.com). Stored in MongoDB demo_requests collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_cloudscore_api.py covers /api/, /api/stats, /api/demo-requests POST/GET incl. validation 422 cases and _id leakage check. Frontend single-page landing all data-testids working. If retest, just rerun pytest and Playwright demo-form flow.
